attr.title: Pocket Tracker Extreme
attr.desc: Pocket Tracker Extreme 0.2.0-beta.1: native music studio for TrimUI Brick / KNULLI. Synth engines, sampling, slicing, groove generation, performance effects and mastering. USB/iPhone compatibility remains device-dependent.
attr.inst: Extract the full ZIP into roms/ports while preserving the existing pockettracker_extreme/data folder. Launch from Ports; no PortMaster startup dependency. Read README.txt.
